jobs.title: Forward Deployed Product Manager - AI Agent (EMEA)
jobs.description: <div class="content-intro"><p>Cresta unlocks the true potential of the customer experience, turning every conversation into a competitive advantage. Cresta’s unified AI platform combines conversational AI agents, real-time human agent augmentation, and comprehensive conversation intelligence to drive revenue and efficiency gains across every channel. The world’s leading companies, including United Airlines, Cox Communications, and Marriott, use Cresta to power world-class customer experiences every day.&nbsp;</p> <p>Born from the Stanford AI Lab, Cresta has raised more than $270 million from the world’s leading investors, including a16z, Greylock, and Sequoia. Cresta’s leadership includes some of the leading minds in AI today. Our CEO, <a href="https://www.linkedin.com/in/pingwu/">Ping Wu</a>, founded and led Google's Contact Center AI and Vertex AI platforms before joining Cresta to build the future of AI-driven customer experiences.</p> <p>Over the next few years, AI is going to redefine how people all over the world interact with businesses every day. Come build that future at Cresta.</p></div><p><strong>About the Role</strong><strong><br></strong></p> <p>As our first EMEA&nbsp;<strong>Forward Deployed Product Manager, AI Agent</strong>, you will create, deploy and optimize AI Agents that transform our customers’ businesses and delight their customers. This highly cross-functional and customer-facing role blends product thinking, a nose for value, and project leadership with senior customer executives. At the end of the day, you own each AI Agent and the outcomes they drive for our customers, and you take that personally. You are a creative, pragmatic problem solver who thrives in fast-paced environments, rolls up your sleeves to build, and excels at turning ambiguity into execution.</p> <p>In this role, you’ll partner with Forward Deployed Engineers (FDEs) who will support the build, integrations and optimization to make each AI Agent successful. You’ll also work closely with product and engineering, providing a tight feedback loop and custom tooling that will shape the future of our platform. As the first hire in EMEA, you’ll also play a key role in setting the standards for the role in the EMEA region and helping to grow the team as we scale.</p> <p><strong>What You’ll Do</strong></p> <ul> <li><strong>Own AI Agent outcomes for our customers</strong> — defining and delivering on the metrics that move the needle. This includes finding additional automation opportunities that can provide even more value! To do this, you’ll…</li> <li><strong>Own the deployment lifecycle</strong> for AI Agents — from scoping and kickoff to launch and post-go-live optimization</li> <li><strong>Design, build, test and iterate on AI agents</strong> in partnership with FDEs using Cresta’s internal tools and the latest technologies to deliver the highest customer ROI</li> <li><strong>Serve as the AI Agent SME for the EMEA Sales cycle,</strong> partnering on demos, solutioning, and deal reviews to ensure technical feasibility, value articulation, and successful handoff to deployment.</li> <li><strong>Lead customer relationships</strong> and act as the primary point of contact for AI Agent. Help customers move faster to ensure we can deliver quickly and effectively.</li> <li><strong>Facilitate workshops and design sessions</strong> with customer stakeholders to align on agent use cases, workflows, and success criteria</li> <li><strong>Work closely with FDEs</strong> to ensure smooth implementation, build new capabilities as needed and provide feedback and improvements to our broader platform&lt

jobs.title: QA Tester
jobs.description: About Us We're hiring a QA Tester to help us ship reliable software, faster. You'll test new features and releases across our web and mobile products, find and document defects, and help build out our automated test coverage. The role is open to candidates from around 1 to 3 years' experience. About the role and team You'll sit within a cross-functional product squad alongside developers, a product managers and project managers, working in Agile sprints. Quality is a shared responsibility here: you'll be involved from refinement through to release, not just at the end. Key responsibilities Review user stories and acceptance criteria early, asking questions that surface gaps and edge cases before code is written Write and maintain clear test cases, test plans and checklists for new features Carry out manual functional, exploratory, regression and cross-browser/device testing Log defects with clear reproduction steps, evidence and severity, and follow them through to resolution Run regression and smoke tests ahead of releases and give a clear go/no-go view Verify fixes and support release and post-release checks in production Help improve QA processes, documentation and test data management Share product knowledge with the wider team and support colleagues in Customer Success when issues are raised Skills and experience Essential At least 1 year's hands-on experience testing web or mobile software in a commercial setting Solid understanding of the software development lifecycle and testing fundamentals (test types, test design techniques, defect life cycle) Experience writing test cases and raising well-documented bugs Familiarity with an issue tracker and test management tools A methodical, curious mindset and strong attention to detail Clear written and verbal communication, including explaining technical issues to non-technical colleagues Experience in leveraging AI to streamline and automate testing Desirable Some experience with test automation Basic SQL for checking and preparing test data Exposure to CI/CD pipelines (e.g. GitHub Actions) and version control with Git Awareness of accessibility (WCAG), performance or security testing Experience testing B2B SaaS or multi-tenant platforms Benefits As you can see, we are quickly progressing with our ambitious plans and are eager to grow our team of doers to achieve our vision of managing over 2 million properties through our platform across various countries. You can help us shape the future of property management across the globe. Here’s what we offer: A competitive compensation package 25 days annual holiday + 1 additional day for every year served up to 3 years. Flexible working environment including the option to work abroad Private health care for you and immediate family members with discounted gym membership, optical, dental and private GP Enhanced parental leave Life insurance (4x salary) Employee assistance program Company volunteering day and charity salary sacrifice scheme Learning management system powered by Udemy Referral bonus and charity donation if someone you introduce joins the company Season ticket loan, Cycle to work, Electric vehicle and Techscheme programs Pension scheme Work abroad scheme Company-sponsored lunches, dinners and social gatherings Find more English Speaking Jobs in United Kingdom on Arbeitnow

why_matches: Arsema has solid hands-on experience in manual functional, exploratory, regression, and release testing from her QA and Scrum Master role at Ethiojobs and her PM/QA hybrid work at Composity.
She has direct experience reviewing user stories and acceptance criteria early to surface gaps and edge cases before code is written, matching Plentific's shift-left testing expectations.

Her technical toolkit includes basic SQL, issue trackers like Jira/ClickUp, Git, CI/CD exposure via Docker/GitHub, and leveraging AI/Claude to streamline workflows, aligning with the job's essential and desirable requirements.
She meets the 1-3 years experience band, with ~3.5 years of total professional experience.
gaps: The posting mentions building out automated test coverage and lists test automation as a desirable skill; Arsema's formal QA background is primarily manual, exploratory, and API integration testing via Postman rather than dedicated test automation coding.

jobs.title: Business Analyst / Project Manager
jobs.description: Business Analyst / Project Manager Overview We are recruiting on behalf of our client for a Business Analyst / Project Manager. Our client is a UK-based consultancy that works with small business owners to map, measure, and improve how their businesses operate. This role sits at the centre of every client engagement — managing projects through a structured five-stage methodology whilst maintaining the day-to-day client relationship from first conversation through to ongoing support. The successful candidate will split their time between project management and hands-on business analysis, running process-mapping workshops with business owners and ensuring that nothing falls through the cracks across multiple concurrent engagements. This is a fully remote position requiring alignment with UK business hours (GMT/BST). Key Responsibilities Manage multiple client projects simultaneously, tracking the status of each engagement and identifying what is progressing, what is blocked, and what needs immediate attention Own the client relationship day to day — serve as the primary point of contact, communicate progress clearly and honestly, and set realistic expectations on timing and effort Build and maintain detailed project plans and Gantt charts, keeping them accurate as scope, priorities, and deadlines evolve Facilitate workshops and one-to-one sessions with business owners to map end-to-end business processes, producing activity diagrams and flow charts in Miro using standard UML notation Co-ordinate actions, dependencies, and outstanding information across clients, consultants, bookkeepers, and management accountants — chasing what is overdue before it causes delay Identify gaps, bottlenecks, and risks early, raising concerns proactively with the client and the internal team rather than waiting to be asked Maintain clear records of decisions, actions, and owners after every client interaction, and keep overall project status visible to the wider team at all times Requirements Matric (Grade 12) as a minimum; a BCom, National Diploma in Business Administration, or a relevant NQF Level 6–7 qualification is strongly preferred Demonstrated experience in a business analysis role, including requirements elicitation, process documentation, and assumption testing Hands-on project management experience running several projects concurrently, with a track record of delivering on time and communicating clearly when timelines change Proficiency in Miro or a comparable online whiteboard tool, alongside everyday collaboration tools such as task trackers, shared documents, and spreadsheets Confident working directly with clients or external stakeholders, ideally owners or senior leaders of small to medium-sized businesses Comfortable reading and discussing basic financial information — P&L statements, cash flow, and business performance figures — without needing to be a qualified accountant Preferred Experience Prior exposure to financial services, accountancy practice, consulting, or finance operations Familiarity with Xero or similar cloud-based accounting software Experience supporting SMEs in sectors such as construction, e-commerce, or professional services A recognised qualification in project management or business analysis, such as PRINCE2, PMP, or a BABOK-aligned certification Key Competencies * Strong communication skills * High attention to detail * Strong organisational skills * Ability to work independently * Professionalism and reliability Originally posted on Himalayas

jobs.title: Product Manager (AI Agents)
jobs.description: Agentplace is a platform for building AI agents that serve customers: they answer questions, book appointments, handle customer service, and deliver services online. Based in San Francisco, featured in VentureBeat, USA Today, and Fast Company. We’re looking for a Product Manager to help shape Agentplace: decide what we build next, turn user problems into clear specs, and make sure what we ship actually improves activation and retention. This is a hands-on contract role. You’ll work directly with the founder, designers, and agent builders. Fractional and freelance PMs welcome: keep your other clients and work with us on a project basis. What you’ll do: talk to users and understand how they build, publish, and use agents; find where users get stuck (sign-up, first agent, publishing, upgrading); turn findings into prioritized problems and short specs; work with design and engineering to ship improvements and measure results; follow competitors and the AI agent market. Who you are: you’ve owned product decisions, you use AI tools every day, and you’d rather ship a small improvement this week than a big plan next quarter. You might be a fractional or freelance PM working with early-stage startups, a PM from an AI, no-code, or developer tools company, or a product-minded designer or founder. We’re looking for 2+ years of product management, comfort with product analytics (Amplitude, Mixpanel, PostHog, or SQL), clear and short writing, and the ability to prototype yourself with tools like Cursor, Lovable, or v0. Details: remote, contract, paid per project or milestone (hourly is also possible). How to apply: complete a short test task. There’s no time limit. We care about the result, not how long it took. 1) Sign up at agentplace.io, build a simple AI agent for any business, and publish it as public. Use the Luna model, it’s free. 2) Write a one-page product review: the 3 biggest problems you ran into as a new user, how you’d prioritize them and why, and a short spec for the top one with the one metric that shows it worked. Send the link to your agent and your one-pager to . Applications are reviewed by email only. Applications without the completed test task will not be considered. We review applications quickly and will reach out to successful candidates with an offer. Originally posted on Himalayas

jobs.description: At Zyte, we eat data for breakfast and you can eat your breakfast anywhere and work for Zyte. Founded in 2010, we are a globally distributed team of over 250 Zytans working from over 28 countries who are on a mission to enable our customers to extract the data they need to continue to innovate and grow their businesses. We believe that all businesses deserve a smooth pathway to data. Role Overview Data QA is how we make sure the data we deliver is right before the customer sees it. As a Data QA Engineer, you will check the data our spiders and AI-assisted projects produce against what the customer asked for, find what is wrong and tell the team exactly what you found. Quality assurance is more useful as a question asked at the start than a gate at the end. Is this requirement testable and how would we know if it were wrong? Part of this role is asking that question early, so problems are fixed before they reach the customer. Key Responsibilities Turn customer scraping and data requirements into a clear test approach and own QA from the start on new projects. Combine exploratory manual and visual testing with automated tests where automation pays for itself. Run test cycles on extracted data and report the results clearly. Write up defects with enough detail that a developer can reproduce and fix them without a conversation. Use descriptive statistics, summaries and charts to show how good the data is: completeness, accuracy, consistency and drift. Produce test reports and quality scores that give the team, and the customer where needed, a true picture. Say what was tested, what was not, and what risk that leaves. Work with project managers and clients to clear up unclear or untestable requirements before QA begins. Feed into our test automation framework, with a focus on coverage and performance. Suggest and take ownership of improvements to QA process and tooling, including browser add-ons, spreadsheet add-ons and UI-based test automation tools. Work with QA leadership, project managers and developers, with minimal supervision. 5+ years in a QA Engineer or similar role - testing software or data. Python preferred language - Pandas and Jupyter for data analysis and validation. SQL: basic to intermediate queries, and comfort with at least one relational database and its tools. A solid grasp of web technologies and protocols: HTML, XPath, JSON, HTTP and CSS. Experience writing tests against HTTP/REST APIs. Proactive and detail-oriented QA professional with a strong sense of ownership over project quality. Fast learner adept at rapidly understanding complex project domain requirements and adapting to new technologies. Leveraging AI and LLM tools to optimize test case generation and accelerate data validation processes. Good test case design and test data management. Experience working in an agile team (Scrum or Kanban) alongside developers. An understanding of data quality concepts such as completeness, accuracy, consistency and drift. Strong attention to detail, and the confidence to hold the quality line under delivery pressure. Clear written and spoken communication in English. Nice to Have Working knowledge of Scrapy and other Python-based scraping frameworks. Experience with test automation frameworks. Interest in data science concepts as they apply to data analysis and validation. Interest in using AI and LLM tools to speed up data validation. As a new Zytan, you will: Become part of a self-motivated, progressive, multi-cultural team. Have the freedom and flexibility to work from where you do your best work. Work with cutting-edge open source technologies and tools. 35 days paid holidays

jobs.description: We are FundCount , an international fintech company with a 20-year track record of delivering innovative solutions. Our unified software platform powers investment, general, and partnership accounting, providing operational efficiency and insights to family offices, fund administrators, and alternative fund managers worldwide. We’re looking for a Manual QA Engineer to join our growing Quality Assurance team. As part of our team, you’ll play a crucial role in ensuring the quality and reliability of our product. You'll engage in manual testing to uncover bugs and work closely with our development team to ensure flawless releases. We are a fully remote company, and you can work from anywhere except Russia and Belarus. About the Product & Team: Our technology stack includes: Java (Hibernate, Spring, Swing, JUnit4, Mockito) Gradle PostgreSQL, MySQL Git We follow a one-month release cycle, freezing code two weeks before each release. We document our processes in Confluence and manage our tasks in Jira (in English). The development team primarily communicates in Russian via Slack. Our QA team consists of 8 engineers. What you will do: Perform thorough manual testing of desktop and web applications. Write detailed bug reports in Jira. Create and maintain test cases in TestRail. Collaborate with developers and product teams throughout the development lifecycle. What we expect from you: 2+ years of experience in manual testing. Solid understanding of Agile methodologies, SDLC, and CI/CD practices. Intermediate or higher English proficiency (written). Ability to independently research and gather information from documentation and public sources. Adaptability to work with different technologies and tools, with a focus-solving rather than specific experience. Technical Skills: Experience testing both desktop and web (frontend and backend) applications. Proficient in SQL and the ability to write DML queries. Confident in working with Windows/Linux terminals.Experience with version control systems (Git). Ability to read and interpret application logs and troubleshoot stack traces. Familiarity with scripting languages like PowerShell, Bash, or cmd/bat. Would be nice if: Basic programming knowledge in any language. Experience or interest in accounting, finance, or investment (e.g., personal involvement in stock markets). We will be glad to offer you: Fully remote work with a flexible schedule. Corporate benefits. Transparent processes with minimal bureaucracy. If you’re ready to contribute to a fast-growing fintech company and work with a talented team, we’d love to hear from you. Apply today! Originally posted on Himalayas

From hobbyists to multinational corporations, teams of every size use Tailscale each day to protect their networks, share access to internal tools, and more. We’re building a future for the Internet that’s easy, sensible, and safe, like it used to be. Founded in 2019 and fully distributed, we’re backed by Accel, CRV, Insight, Heavybit, and Uncork Capital. About the Role We’re seeking a talented and motivated full-time Program Manager to join our team. This is a tactical, implementation-focused role , hands-on in shaping how EPD (Engineering, Product & Design) operates, works together, and stays productive: building and refining the processes and rhythms that keep the org running, driving improvement initiatives over time, and owning the processes behind EPD’s operational health. You’ll help the team understand trends and spot where improvements are needed. Because we’re an early-stage and fully remote company, we’re looking for an individual who can work independently to align the teams involved in building the product. A deep understanding of the technical engineering space (how engineering teams operate, where the friction points typically live, and what good looks like) is essential to being effective and credible in this role. Ability to think on one’s feet, enjoy collaborating with highly technical teams, operate comfortably in ambiguity without a clearly defined deliverable, and be comfortable working asynchronously is essential. Key Responsibilities You will work as part of the TPM team to: Own the processes for bug tracking, incidents, reliability, and escalations, and continuously improve them to drive efficiency and progress toward EPD’s operational health goals. Spot trends across operational health data and translate them into clear insights on how EPD is doing and where improvement is needed. Build dashboards and reports in tools like Jira and Snowflake that give EPD and the broader company visibility into operational health and progress. Turn data into a clear story: what it’s telling us, why it matters, and what needs to change, then design and implement the process changes to act on it. Identify process gaps with EPD and proactively develop just the right amount of process to fill the gap: not too much, not too little. Support planning activities and project tracking processes, helping keep them running smoothly and consistently across EPD. Help run project status reviews, leadership roadmap reviews, and priority reviews, making sure the right information is ready and the right people are in the room. Connect the dots across systems, processes, and teams, spotting where disconnected efforts overlap, conflict, or could be simplified, and acting on it. Jump in on whatever initiative pops up in EPD that needs support, structure, or someone to help carry it forward, whether or not it fits inside a defined program. Handle project retrospectives involving participants and stakeholders to understand what went well and what should be adjusted in future project work. Seek opportunities to bring about ongoing improvement and simplification in business operating procedures and practices, leading to improved efficiency and effectiveness. jobs.title: Product Owner, Xsolla Partner Network
jobs.description: About You We are looking for a Product Owner to join the team behind Xsolla Partner Network (XPN). The role is based in the US, and we’re open to strong candidates globally. Partner Network connects game publishers with content creators to drive discovery, engagement, and revenue. XPN is a two-sided marketplace. We help publishers run creator marketing campaigns (xsolla.com/partner-network), and we give creators a way to join those campaigns, along with tools to manage and grow their channels (xsolla.com/for/creators). Each side has its own users and goals, and each shapes the other. Helping both sides succeed together is what makes this role so interesting. You’ll work closely with customers on both sides and with a collaborative team that’s building something new in the creator economy. You’ll bring what you learn back to the Product Director and the team, help shape where the product goes, and then work alongside design and engineering to bring it to life. This is a hands-on role that mixes customer conversations, product definition, and day-to-day delivery. If you enjoy turning what you learn from customers into shipped features, and you like doing it with a team that moves fast and supports each other, we’d love to meet you. About Us Xsolla is a global commerce company with robust tools and services to help developers solve the inherent challenges of the video game industry. From indie to AAA, companies partner with Xsolla to help them fund, distribute, market, and monetize their games. Grounded in the belief in the future of video games, Xsolla is resolute in the mission to bring opportunities together, and continually make new resources available to creators. Headquartered and incorporated in Los Angeles, California, Xsolla operates as the merchant of record and has helped over 1,500+ game developers to reach more players and grow their businesses around the world. With more paths to profits and ways to win, developers have all the things needed to enjoy the game. For more information, visit xsolla.com. Responsibilities: Research and discovery. Get to know both sides of the XPN marketplace: the game publishers running creator campaigns and the creators bringing those campaigns to life. Talk with customers, gather insights, and keep up with trends in the creator economy and gaming. What you learn shapes where the product goes next. Coordinate the roadmap. Work with the Product Director to turn insights into priorities. Bring ideas and recommendations, balance publisher and creator needs, and help build a roadmap the whole team is excited about. Write product requirements. Turn ideas into clear, well-scoped PRDs that give design and engineering what they need to build with confidence. Manage delivery. Organize the work in Jira and keep design, engineering, and QA aligned and moving from kickoff through release. Track what matters. Define and follow the metrics that show how XPN is working for publishers and creators, and use them to guide what we build next. Keep everyone connected. Be the hub for product communication. Share project status, research, and customer insights with the product team. Keep Business Development, Customer Success, and Marketing up to date on what’s shipping and what it means for our partners. Requirements: Product experience. 3+ years in product management or product ownership, shipping software alongside a dedicated engineering team. Customer insight. You enjoy talking with customers and turning those conversations into insights that shape product decisions. You’re comfortable serving more than one type of user and finding solutions that work for everyone involved. Clear writing. You write product requirements that are easy to follow and help the team get aligned quickly. Engineering partnership. You work closely with engineers day to day, making scope and sequencing decisions together, and you’re comfortable managing the backlog and tracking work

jobs.title: Product Manager at Tratta
jobs.description: About Tratta Tratta is the platform that powers credit and collections at scale, and we try to make it enjoyable to work on. Our clients are collection agencies and law firms recovering debt from consumers. Their account data lands in Tratta and is mapped and validated on the way in. They run email and SMS campaigns off it. Consumers land on a payment portal carrying the client's brand, where they can pay, negotiate a plan or sign an agreement electronically without ever speaking to a collector. Payments clear through us by card, ACH or check, and it all feeds back into reporting that shapes the next campaign. Campaigns, data and payments as one closed loop instead of four vendors stitched together. Every week that loop moves millions of dollars in payments, ingests nearly 100 million rows of client data and serves almost 10 million API requests. About the Product Team The product team is small: two PMs, one designer and a distributed engineering team of about ten. You would be our second product hire. There is no product ops layer, no analyst and no one sitting between you and the client, or between you and the code. The role You will own a set of topics end to end. Not "manage a backlog" in the abstract, but pick up messy input from clients and customer success, turn it into something the team can build, get it shipped, and then make sure it actually gets used. Turn requests into work. Client and CS requests arrive as symptoms, not specs. You dig into what is actually being asked, decide whether it is a bug, a gap, a training problem or a real product need, and write it up so a developer can pick it up without a meeting. Prioritize. You decide what gets built next among a lot of competing, legitimate asks, and you can explain the reasoning to a client, a developer and a founder in three different ways. Firefight. Bugs and urgent client issues will land on you. You triage, reproduce, escalate the real ones, and close the loop with whoever raised it. Discovery. You help figure out what we should build next, from client conversations, usage data and your own read of the market. Data. You are comfortable with data end to end: getting it, questioning it, and deciding what to do about it. Own outcomes, not output. Shipping is the midpoint, not the finish line. If a feature launches and nobody knows it exists or nobody adopts it, that is your problem to solve. You will write the client email, record the walkthrough, check the numbers a month later and tell us honestly whether it worked. Wear multiple hats. Small changes you can do yourself with Claude, you do yourself. Otherwise: specs, debugging, data and dashboards, release notes, client emails, whatever the topic needs. There is no one to hand it to. What this role is not It is not a role where you write requirements and hand them to someone else. It is not a role with a defined scope that stays defined. And it is not a role where you can be effective while waiting to be told what to do. How we work Very little process and very few meetings. No planning ritual that exists to justify the previous planning ritual. If something is not working, we change it the next day. The tradeoff is that nothing will be handed to you. There is no queue of pre-groomed tickets, no one checking whether you did the thing, and no process to hide behind if a topic quietly stalls. Autonomy and accountability come as a pair here. We use Claude heavily across product work: analysis, drafting, prototyping, bulk operations across Linear, Slack, HubSpot and our data. Being fluent with AI tooling is not a bonus point, it is how the job gets done at this team size.
